name: Dolma: 3-Trillion Token Open Corpus for Pretraining
description: Dolma is an open-source, 3-trillion-token English text dataset designed for language model pretraining, developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2). Created to accompany the fully open OLMo model family, Dolma is assembled from diverse sources including Common Crawl web pages, Semantic Scholar academic papers, open-source GitHub code, Project Gutenberg books, Wikipedia, and Reddit discussions. The dataset is produced via an open-source, high-performance processing toolkit featuring language identification, toxic content filtering, PII removal, and MinHash deduplication.
